title: “Federal loan relief” has your balance
scenario: A caller says they work with a government student-loan relief program and correctly quotes your approximate balance. They can lower payments if you provide your loan account login and pay an enrollment fee.

answers.A: Pay the fee if the quoted balance matches your real debt, since that suggests database access.
answers.B: Use the official loan servicer/government portal to check eligibility and never hand an incoming caller your account login.
answers.C: Ask for the program name and verify it independently with your loan servicer or financial-aid office.

explanation: Loan balances can be obtained through breaches or data brokers. Eligibility should be verified through the actual loan system.
proTip: Knowing your debt does not make someone your lender.
